subject: Contract refresh planning: license uplift, capacity buffer, and QBR slotting
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara@churnless.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Contract refresh planning: license uplift, capacity buffer, and QBR slotting

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed on the call, Churnless is approaching your contract renewal window in November and we wanted to kick off a short planning thread to align on the proposed license uplift, an interim capacity buffer for peak campaigns, and to lock a QBR slot for a final sign-off. High level ask: confirm headcount-based uplift (from 120 to 180 seats), agree on a one‑month burst pool for campaign spikes, and schedule a 60‑minute QBR in late Oct/early Nov for sign-off and SOW review.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (draft), usage_report_aug2026.csv

Proposed timeline (fast path):
- Week of Sep 28: internal procurement review at Churnless / finalize SOW comments
- Oct 5–9: Redwood sends final SOW & pricing appendix
- Week of Oct 19: QBR (60 min) for leadership approval
- Nov 1: contract effective date (if approved)

Can you confirm who on your side will lead procurement review, and which dates in the Oct 19–30 window work best for a 60‑minute meeting? We can be flexible with timezones. Also copying Ben and Marissa from our side — they’ll own commercial details and implementation onboarding respectively.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0142

---
From: Sara Liu <sara@churnless.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Churnless Procurement <procurement@churnless.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract refresh planning: license uplift, capacity buffer, and QBR slotting

Thanks Rachel —

Appreciate the clear timeline. I’ll lead the procurement review and loop in our VP of Ops (cc’d procurement alias). Quick responses to your asks:

- License uplift: the headcount model you proposed (120->180) looks right, but I need to confirm with finance for a capex/opex split.
- Capacity buffer: we’ll want the one‑month burst, but can we scope it as a 20% additional token capacity rather than seats? That maps closer to our campaign needs.
- QBR dates: Oct 20 or Oct 27, afternoons PT, work best for our execs.

I’ll collect procurement’s initial comments by Sep 25 and send them back. If you have a short summary doc that maps seat uplift -> estimated monthly cost and an alternate token‑burst pricing option, that would be super helpful.

Thanks —
Sara
Head of Growth, Churnless.ai
---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prep for Churnless procurement ask

Rachel / Marissa —

Re: Churnless procurement wanting a tokenized burst option: I’ll pull alternative pricing scenarios tonight. Action items for us:
1) Create a 1‑page commercial summary comparing (A) headcount uplift pricing and (B) token burst pricing with estimated monthly costs and 90‑day forecast.
2) Draft an SOW appendix that clarifies the burst pool mechanics (how burst is billed, retention, and rollback triggers).
3) Prepare a concise pricing note for finance that shows impact to ARR and month‑over‑month cashflow under both options.

I’ve started a draft in the deal workspace: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/RDW-2026-0931 (will add the commercial summary and sample billing table). Marissa — can you draft the implementation checklist for onboarding 60 additional seats and a plan to provision the burst pool?

Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara@churnless.ai>, Churnless Procurement <procurement@churnless.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract refresh planning: license uplift, capacity buffer, and QBR slotting

Sara — thanks for the quick reply and for leading procurement. Oct 20 at 2:00pm PT is available on our side — I’ve tentatively reserved that slot. If that becomes a hard no, we can move to Oct 27 afternoon.

Next steps (action owners):
- Sara: procurement feedback by Sep 25 (noted)
- Ben: commercial summary + burst pricing scenarios by Sep 17 (he’s already on it)
- Marissa: onboarding checklist + provisioning plan by Sep 22
- Rachel: finalize SOW and send DocuSign link once procurement sign‑off is received

Attached is the latest draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf) and August usage snapshot (usage_report_aug2026.csv). I’ll update the deal workspace and share the DocuSign link once we’ve incorporated procurement comments.

Looking forward — we’ll treat this as a short, timeboxed project to get you into the new capacity ahead of the holiday campaign season.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
